wants.Heather: Restore the garden with willing companions, then finish one quiet cup of chai.

actual_changes.after:
Buddy had liked the nursery. Nothing there had asked him to help.

The trio returned with an assortment

actual_changes.before: Neet’s ears perked up at the sound of Heather’s determined voice, mistaking her enthusiasm for a call to action.
actual_changes.after:
Buddy selected a patch of shade beside the wall. Neet selected a job before Heather could give him one.

His ears perked up at the sound of Heather’s determined voice, mistaking her enthusiasm for a call to action.

actual_changes.before: Heather groaned while Neet pranced victoriously, his tail wagging like a banner of mischief.
actual_changes.after:
Heather groaned while Neet pranced victoriously, his tiny nub twitching.

She lifted the cup and stared into it.

“Lovely. I’m growing lunch in my breakfast.”

Neet leaned forward to inspect his work. Heather moved the cup away.

actual_changes.before: The squirrel easily outmaneuvered him, scurrying up a tree while Buddy’s enthusiastic chase left deep paw prints in the newly prepared beds.
actual_changes.after:
The squirrel easily outmaneuvered him, scurrying up the tree beside the wall. Buddy’s enthusiastic chase left deep paw prints in the newly prepared beds. It had taken him less time to spoil a row than Heather had taken to make it.

The squirrel returned to the wall. Buddy lifted a paw, ready for another attempt.

actual_changes.before:
“Buddy, no! The carrots go there!” Heather exclaimed, rushing to smooth out the mess. Buddy returned to her side, panting. He looked from his paw prints to Heather’s smoothing hand, then stepped carefully onto the bare terrace. The squirrel could keep the tree.

![Buddy steps off the disturbed garden bed while Neet stands beside scattered seeds, some already floating in the chai.](../Productions/E008-garden-rebirth-with-chaos/illustration-v001.png)
actual_changes.after:
“Buddy, no! The carrots go there!” Heather exclaimed. Buddy looked down at his raised paw. Beneath it lay the next perfectly smooth stretch of soil.

![Buddy pauses with one paw raised in the disturbed bed while Neet stands over the torn tomato packet and seeds float in the chai.](../Productions/E008-garden-rebirth-with-chaos/illustration-v001.png)

He turned carefully toward the bare terrace. Heather knelt to smooth out his tracks. Buddy watched her finish, then took the long way round the bed to reach his shade. The squirrel could keep the tree.

actual_changes.before: Then, with a growl, he launched himself at it, barking furiously and clawing at its base.
actual_changes.after:
The gnome smiled back.

Neet moved to the left. The gnome kept smiling. He moved to the right. Same smile.

Buddy came over, sniffed the pointed hat, and lost interest.

“It’s a pot with a face.”

“Then why is it looking at us?”

Buddy glanced at the empty flower pots. He was not starting this with all of them.

Then, with a growl, Neet launched himself at the gnome, barking furiously and clawing at its base.

actual_changes.before: “Neet, it’s just a gnome!” Heather said, doubling over with laughter.
actual_changes.after:
“Neet, it’s just a gnome!” Heather said, doubling over with laughter.

The gnome did not help her explain.

actual_changes.before: Neet, on the other hand, had declared war on the garden hose, leaping and snapping at the water spray as Heather attempted to irrigate the soil.
actual_changes.after:
Neet, on the other hand, had declared war on the garden hose, leaping and snapping at the water spray as Heather attempted to irrigate the soil.

She shut off the nozzle. Neet landed, planted all four paws, and stared down the last drops.

He had won.

Heather opened it again. Neet’s mouth fell open with fresh outrage. Buddy, still dry beside the wall, tucked his paws farther into the shade.

actual_changes.before: The soil beds were smooth again, the lime sapling upright, and the herbs hanging safely above the dogs.
actual_changes.after: The soil beds were smooth again, the lime sapling upright, and the herbs hanging safely above the dogs. Heather rinsed her cup and set it on a higher shelf. She had learned something about planting, too.
